title: Detailed present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Box body -->
  <rect x="18" y="48" width="64" height="42" rx="4" fill="#E8434A"/>
  <!-- Box top face (lid) -->
  <rect x="14" y="38" width="72" height="14" rx="4" fill="#FF5A63"/>
  <!-- Lid top shading -->
  <rect x="14" y="38" width="72" height="5" rx="4" fill="#FF8087"/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon on box -->
  <rect x="44" y="48" width="12" height="42" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x="44" y="38" width="12" height="14" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon around box -->
  <rect x="18" y="64" width="64" height="10" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon highlight -->
  <rect x="18" y="64" width="64" height="3" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <!-- Ribbon vertical highlight -->
  <rect x="46" y="48" width="3" height="42" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <rect x="46" y="38" width="3" height="14" fill="#FFF2A8"/>

  <!-- Ribbon knot center -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FFE066"/>

  <!-- Left bow loop -->
  <path d="M50 36 C40 24, 22 20, 20 32 C18 44, 38 42, 50 36 Z" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <path d="M50 36 C42 28, 28 25, 25 33 C22 41, 38 40, 50 36 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <!-- Left bow loop shading -->
  <path d="M50 36 C44 30, 33 27, 29 33" stroke="#FFB800" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Right bow loop -->
  <path d="M50 36 C60 24, 78 20, 80 32 C82 44, 62 42, 50 36 Z" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <path d="M50 36 C58 28, 72 25, 75 33 C78 41, 62 40, 50 36 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <path d="M50 36 C56 30, 67 27, 71 33" stroke="#FFB800" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Left bow tail -->
  <path d="M48 38 C40 48, 32 56, 28 60 L34 62 C38 56, 46 46, 50 40 Z" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <path d="M49 39 C43 47, 35 54, 31 58" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Right bow tail -->
  <path d="M52 38 C60 48, 68 56, 72 60 L66 62 C62 56, 54 46, 50 40 Z" fill="#FFC300"/>
  <path d="M51 39 C57 47, 65 54, 69 58" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Small sparkle details on box -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="76" r="2" fill="#FF8087" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="76" r="2" fill="#FF8087" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#FF8087" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#FF8087" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Lid edge highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="38" width="72" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFB3B7" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Bow knot small shine -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="33" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#FFF8D6" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
